transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, the board has authorized us to consider repurchasing up to 5,000,000 common shares this quarter. Our stock is trading near $8.25, and we have the reported cash to support a repurchase. Before I make the binding authorization decision, I'd like to hear input from treasury, legal and compliance, and investor relations as part of our standing capital-return review. Let's start with treasury — what are your thoughts on pricing, offer size, and execution method?
